import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.titleweight": "normal",
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.labelsize": 11,
    "ytick.labelsize": 11,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

# ── Color palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────
CLR = {
    "bg": "#fffff8", "text": "#111111", "text2": "#666666", "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc", "grid": "#eeeeee", "highlight": "#e41a1c",
    "steel": "#4e79a7", "tangerine": "#f28e2b", "coral": "#e15759",
    "sage": "#76b7b2", "purple": "#b07aa1", "gray": "#666666",
    "bronze_c": "#b8860b", "silver_c": "#708090", "gold_c": "#b8860b",
}

CAT_COLORS = {
    "IoT/Streaming": "#4e79a7",
    "Enterprise Apps": "#76b7b2",
    "Logs/Clickstream": "#b07aa1",
    "External/3rd Party": "#e15759",
    "Databases": "#f28e2b",
    "Ingestion Engine": "#4e79a7",
    "Raw Zone": "#c78b4a",
    "Curated Zone": "#708090",
    "Business Zone": "#b8860b",
    "BI": "#4e79a7",
    "ML": "#e15759",
    "API": "#f28e2b",
    "Reverse ETL": "#76b7b2",
}

# ── Load data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

node_map = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes}

# ── Layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LAYERS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {"source": 0.04, "ingestion": 0.195, "bronze": 0.35,
           "silver": 0.505, "gold": 0.66, "consumption": 0.815}

# Group and sort
nodes_by_layer = {}
for L in LAYERS:
    layer_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n["layer"] == L]
    layer_nodes.sort(key=lambda n: (n.get("category", ""), -(n.get("daily_volume_gb") or 0)))
    nodes_by_layer[L] = layer_nodes

# Compute vertical positions (centered per layer)
TOP = 0.88
BOTTOM = 0.10
NODE_H = 0.019
PAD = 0.008
CAT_PAD = 0.022

positions = {}
node_sizes = {}

for L in LAYERS:
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[L]
    # Group by category
    cats = {}
    for n in layer_nodes:
        cats.setdefault(n.get("category", "Other"), []).append(n)

    # Compute total height for this layer
    total_h = sum(NODE_H + PAD for _ in layer_nodes) - PAD  # remove last pad
    # Add category padding
    cat_count = len(cats)
    if cat_count > 1:
        total_h += (cat_count - 1) * CAT_PAD

    # Center vertically
    start_y = (TOP + BOTTOM) / 2 + total_h / 2

    y = start_y
    first_cat = True
    for cat, cat_nodes in cats.items():
        if not first_cat:
            y -= CAT_PAD
        first_cat = False
        for n in cat_nodes:
            y -= NODE_H / 2
            positions[n["node_id"]] = (layer_x[L], y)
            node_sizes[n["node_id"]] = (0.14, NODE_H)
            y -= NODE_H / 2 + PAD

# ── Create figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 15), dpi=150)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.axis("off")

# ── Edge drawing ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, volume, mode="batch", alpha=0.32):
    if volume is None:
        volume = 3
    lw = 0.4 + 4.0 * np.log1p(volume) / np.log1p(550)
    lw = min(lw, 5.5)

    mode_colors = {"streaming": "#4e79a7", "batch": "#999999",
                   "cdc": "#e15759", "query": "#76b7b2"}
    edge_c = mode_colors.get(mode, "#bbbbbb")
    ls = (0, (3, 2)) if mode == "query" else "solid"

    # Curved bezier
    cp1_x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * 0.3
    cp2_x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * 0.7
    cp1_y, cp2_y = y1, y2

    t = np.linspace(0, 1, 50)
    bx = (1-t)**3 * x1 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * cp1_x + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * cp2_x + t**3 * x2
    by = (1-t)**3 * y1 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * cp1_y + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * cp2_y + t**3 * y2

    ax.plot(bx, by, color=edge_c, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
            linestyle=ls, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=1)

# Draw all edges first (behind nodes)
for e in edges:
    src_id = e["source"]
    tgt_id = e["target"]
    if src_id in positions and tgt_id in positions:
        x1, y1 = positions[src_id]
        x2, y2 = positions[tgt_id]
        vol = e.get("volume_gb") or 3
        mode = e.get("mode", "batch")
        draw_edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, vol, mode, alpha=0.24)

# ── Node drawing ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, label, x, y, w, h, color, fontsize=7):
    # Background rect
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.9,
        zorder=10, linewidth=0,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Label
    display = label if len(label) <= 24 else label[:22] + "\u2026"
    ax.text(x, y, display, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=fontsize, color="#111", fontfamily="serif",
            fontweight="bold", zorder=11)

for n in nodes:
    nid = n["node_id"]
    if nid in positions:
        x, y = positions[nid]
        w, h = node_sizes[nid]
        cat = n.get("category", "Other")
        color = CAT_COLORS.get(cat, CLR["gray"])
        draw_node(ax, n["label"], x, y, w, h, color, fontsize=6.5)

# ── Volume labels for source nodes only ─────────────────────────
for n in nodes:
    if n["layer"] == "source" and n.get("daily_volume_gb"):
        nid = n["node_id"]
        if nid in positions:
            x, y = positions[nid]
            vol = n["daily_volume_gb"]
            fig.text(x - 0.074, y, f"{vol} GB/d", ha="right", va="center",
                     fontsize=6.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text3"],
                     transform=fig.transFigure)

# ── Volume labels for ingestion nodes ───────────────────────────
for n in nodes:
    if n["layer"] == "ingestion" and n.get("daily_volume_gb"):
        nid = n["node_id"]
        if nid in positions:
            x, y = positions[nid]
            vol = n["daily_volume_gb"]
            fig.text(x + 0.075, y, f"{vol} GB/d", ha="left", va="center",
                     fontsize=6.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text3"],
                     transform=fig.transFigure)

# ── Layer headers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_titles = {
    "source": "SOURCES\n(10 systems, 5 categories)",
    "ingestion": "INGESTION\nBatch | Stream | CDC",
    "bronze": "BRONZE \u2014 Raw\nSchema-on-Read",
    "silver": "SILVER \u2014 Curated\nCleanse \u00b7 Enrich \u00b7 Conform",
    "gold": "GOLD \u2014 Business\nAggregate \u00b7 KPI \u00b7 Features",
    "consumption": "CONSUMPTION\nBI \u00b7 ML \u00b7 API \u00b7 Rev ETL",
}

for L in LAYERS:
    x = layer_x[L]
    lines = layer_titles[L].split("\n")
    fig.text(x, TOP + 0.025, lines[0], ha="center", va="bottom",
             fontsize=10.5, fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold",
             color=CLR["text"], transform=fig.transFigure)
    if len(lines) > 1:
        fig.text(x, TOP + 0.013, lines[1], ha="center", va="top",
                 fontsize=7.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text2"],
                 transform=fig.transFigure)

# ── Subtle vertical rule between layers ─────────────────────────
for L in LAYERS:
    x = layer_x[L]
    ax.axvline(x=x, ymin=BOTTOM-0.02, ymax=TOP+0.03,
               color=CLR["axis"], linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

# ── Governance sidebar (right column) ───────────────────────────
gov_x = 0.935
gov_top = TOP - 0.05

fig.text(gov_x, gov_top + 0.025, "GOVERNANCE CONTROLS",
         ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9.5, fontfamily="serif",
         fontweight="bold", color=CLR["text"], transform=fig.transFigure)

# Group by layer
gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by_layer.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

gov_layer_order = ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption", "cross-layer"]
gov_layer_short = {
    "ingestion": "Ingestion", "bronze": "Bronze", "silver": "Silver",
    "gold": "Gold", "consumption": "Consumption", "cross-layer": "Cross-Layer",
}
enf_icons = {"automated": "[A]", "policy-based": "[P]", "manual": "[M]", "scheduled": "[S]"}

gy = gov_top
for L in gov_layer_order:
    if L not in gov_by_layer:
        continue
    gy -= 0.020
    fig.text(gov_x, gy, gov_layer_short[L], ha="center", va="top",
             fontsize=7, fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold",
             color=CLR["text2"], transform=fig.transFigure)
    gy -= 0.014
    for g in gov_by_layer[L]:
        icon = enf_icons.get(g["enforcement"], "[?]")
        fig.text(gov_x, gy, f"{icon} {g['control_type']}",
                 ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif",
                 color=CLR["text3"], transform=fig.transFigure)
        gy -= 0.0115
    gy -= 0.006

# ── Transformation summary (below medallion layers) ─────────────
tx_x = {"bronze": layer_x["bronze"], "silver": layer_x["silver"], "gold": layer_x["gold"]}
tx_y = BOTTOM - 0.04

fig.text(0.505, tx_y + 0.018, "TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY",
         ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, fontfamily="serif",
         fontweight="bold", color=CLR["text"], transform=fig.transFigure)

for L in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    items = [t for t in transforms if t["layer"] == L]
    total_tx = sum(t["count"] for t in items)
    high_ct = sum(1 for t in items if t["complexity"] == "high")
    med_ct = sum(1 for t in items if t["complexity"] == "medium")
    low_ct = sum(1 for t in items if t["complexity"] == "low")

    x = tx_x[L]
    fig.text(x, tx_y, f"{total_tx} total  |  H:{high_ct}  M:{med_ct}  L:{low_ct}",
             ha="center", va="top", fontsize=7, fontfamily="serif",
             fontweight="bold", color=CLR["text2"], transform=fig.transFigure)

    # Top 2 transformation types
    sorted_items = sorted(items, key=lambda t: -t["count"])[:2]
    y_off = 0.012
    for t in sorted_items:
        fig.text(x, tx_y - y_off, f"{t['transformation_type']} ({t['count']})",
                 ha="center", va="top", fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif",
                 color=CLR["text3"], fontstyle="italic", transform=fig.transFigure)
        y_off += 0.010

# ── Edge mode legend ────────────────────────────────────────────
ly = BOTTOM + 0.025
legend_items = [
    ("Streaming", "#4e79a7", "solid"),
    ("Batch", "#999999", "solid"),
    ("CDC", "#e15759", "solid"),
    ("Query", "#76b7b2", "dashed"),
]
fig.text(0.04, ly + 0.01, "Edge mode",
         fontsize=7.5, fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold",
         color=CLR["text2"], transform=fig.transFigure)
for i, (label, color, ls) in enumerate(legend_items):
    lx = 0.04 + i * 0.055
    ax.plot([lx, lx + 0.025], [ly - 0.006, ly - 0.006],
            color=color, linewidth=1.8, linestyle=ls,
            transform=fig.transFigure, solid_capstyle="round")
    fig.text(lx + 0.028, ly - 0.006, label,
             fontsize=6.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text3"],
             va="center", transform=fig.transFigure)

# ── Title block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.04, 0.975,
         "Data Lakehouse Architecture: End-to-End Pipeline, Governance, and Consumption",
         fontsize=19, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text"],
         fontweight="bold", transform=fig.transFigure)

fig.text(0.04, 0.955,
         "1,560 GB/day across 10 sources \u2192 3 ingestion engines \u2192 Bronze (raw) \u2192 Silver (curated) \u2192 Gold (business) \u2192 6 consumption endpoints",
         fontsize=10.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text2"],
         transform=fig.transFigure)

fig.text(0.04, 0.938,
         "IoT/streaming paths carry 64% of total volume (980 GB/d via Stream Ingestion) \u00b7 15 governance controls span all layers \u00b7 Gold datasets fan out to BI, ML training, API services, and Reverse ETL",
         fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=CLR["text3"], fontstyle="italic",

source_cats = {}
for n in nodes:
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        source_cats.setdefault(n["category"], []).append(n)

# Draw subtle category brackets on left side of source column

for cat, cat_nodes in source_cats.items():
    if len(cat_nodes) < 2:

    ys = [positions[n["node_id"]][1] + node_sizes[n["node_id"]][1]/2 + 0.003
          for n in cat_nodes]
    y_top = max(ys)
    y_bot = min(ys) - node_sizes[cat_nodes[-1]["node_id"]][1] - 0.003

    ax.plot([bracket_x, bracket_x], [y_bot, y_top],
            color=CLR["text3"], linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    # Horizontal tick at top
    ax.plot([bracket_x, bracket_x + 0.005], [y_top, y_top],
            color=CLR["text3"], linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    # Horizontal tick at bottom
    ax.plot([bracket_x, bracket_x + 0.005], [y_bot, y_bot],
            color=CLR["text3"], linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
